notes.title: DEMO PATCH v0.1.5⭐
notes.notes:
Hello Space Travelers! 🌟

The last few months have been an insane ride, to say the least - we’ve crash-landed at Gamescom (Cologne) 🇩🇪, PAX West (Seattle) 🇺🇸, Tokyo Game Show (Tokyo) 🇯🇵, Level Up KL (Kuala Lumpur)🇲🇾, and we’re currently in IGDX (Bali) 🇮🇩! Then we’ll be closing the month off at Gamescom Asia (Singapore)🇸🇬 next week!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/78e4fedaaa87bc41494ed126f65c9d8a71a9ff7e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/f375b23a47c79c114fa8af5a3393529e5034f6df.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/be8b206e5cc03ef2a7d6a0162ef48a1be04e41c1.png

We’re extremely exhausted (in the greatest way possible!) and truly grateful for the amazing turnout at all of these events - meeting all of you, hearing all your enthusiasm about the game, capturing Nebula & leaving your beautiful constellations in the universe of I NEED SPACE! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/08643cf90a1d25f8c0d4e701e3edbfaa37eecb4a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/d13ec54680e67c7f60fafd107104879d3e0e9a36.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/0e11e91a8a25ca1bb9c40f526a0f0cc36ecee3fc.png

💫Patch notes v 0.1.5💫

Most importantly, we thank you for all the love! We have been gathering all your feedback to iterate the experience further and we’re now excited to announce ⭐Demo Patch v0.1.5!!⭐ 

This patch improves optimization aspects, adds some UI, and now supports compatibility with Steam Deck!

💫Updates💫
 - Now playable on Steam Deck!
 - Improved the twinkling visual for the Rock Stars to make it more noticeable
 - Adjusted the room under the Home Planet’s well to be more noticeable
 - Adjusted the rocks on the Little Night Moon to reset their position after players Load Checkpoint
 - Added a notification to inform players that they can explore more areas after certain events in-game
 - Adjusted and extended several cutscenes
 - Fixed a bug where location names on the telescope are revealed before the player even got there

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/7ddf1e581249e87d649b66ee33eeb354871c87d6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/f1d806325317313da3e6fbaf8b5c2c3394b92520.png

We hope you enjoy this update - we couldn’t have done so without your help! Stay tuned for more I NEED SPACE news! 🌟

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337180/I_NEED_SPACE/

Laters Explorers!

- El & the Khayalan Arts crew

notes.title: I NEED NEW PATCH v.0.1.4 ✨
notes.notes:

Thank you for the support and hope to see you there! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/10cf8e0ed34c33aafc730827eb14e6d5629890d5.png

With this astronautical milestone - we have also just released a new patch that addresses all your suggestions since Gamescom and PAX West! This patch features several quality-of-life updates and makes for a smoother, more enjoyable experience within this slice of the Catspaw Sector in the Solfege Star System. 

💫 Patch v0.1.4 Updates:

- Added an instant pin removal prompt when placing a new pin using the Telescope
- Added Telescope crosshair
- Adjusted the Oxygen depletion rate
- Adjusted some SFX and BGM volumes
- Fixed some mechanic-related bugs
- Fixed some particle-related bugs
- Fixed some UI-related bugs
- Fixed some dialogue-related bugs
- Fixed some audio-related bugs

If there’s anything else you’d like to see in I NEED SPACE, shoot us a PM or join our [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/jUTgJVnzt6) and chat with us in the #*game-suggestions-📕* channel.

notes.title: DEMO PATCH v0.1.2⭐
notes.notes:
Dear Space Travelers!

We’re releasing Demo Patch v 0.1.2 that allows for more interstellar fun times; 

such as naming the Home Planet & the Cosmicat! ⭐️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/f2dad0a987ef72d1952c194d4d99664f969f6b82.gif

More visually populated galaxy! ⭐️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/1d104c1218ade79c7f2a57afecf681194b9001bf.gif

& many more! ⭐️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/900c92d0f125faf95c7e81e22ca72fc6382d65f2.gif

 💫Updates💫 
- You can now customize the name for the Home planet and the Cosmicat.
- Updated space background visuals with Nebula, Distant planets/ debris & story-related landmarks.
- Added grid to the Constellation mode.
- In-game Constellation can now be saved & viewed in EXTRAS.
- Totems now have dialogues.
- Players can now interact with the Tutus (The small rock creatures).
- Improvements to the player movement and jump physics.
- More minimalistic control scheme for both gamepad & keyboard.
- Improved Journal UI.
- Improved Gameplay UI.
- Cutscenes are now skippable.

✨Write your Ramadhan greetings in the stars!✨
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/a2be7479f367e10bff7c64345e0b2ed25af2013f.gif

Try out the enhanced Constellation Drawing and let your imagination run wild! Write your own special Ramadhan greetings in the stars and submit them to us.

We'll compile all the constellations and post them on our social media pages next week!

---

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337180/I_NEED_SPACE/

Thank you for your feedback, it really helps us improve! If there’s anything else you’d like to see in I NEED SPACE, shoot us a PM or tell us in Discord #game-suggestions-📕

May this month bring you closer to your loved ones, and may it be filled with countless moments of peace, reflection, and gratitude.

Laters Explorers!
- El & the Khayalan Arts crew

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.1.1⭐
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers!

We’re releasing a patch that addresses optimization issues encountered in the previous demo build, along with some additional UI & improvements to game feedbacks. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770387/47250d7222ed02298ff2f45cec8c0881413bad58.png

FIXES:
- Improved performance by increasing framerate and loading system
- Changed how particle system is moved
- Changed some UI for clarity & better user flow
- Changed some item description to improve clarity
- Fixed volume settings not adjusting when slider is moved using mouse
- Fixed a bug where the Cosmicat keeps running after being caught while running
- Fixed several player animation glitches
- Fixed trailer audio not adjusted to volume settings
- Added tutorial & terms for space exploration > Access in Cockpit view > Flight Manual
- Added extra dialogue for Wadu
- Highway of Junks can now interact with cluster objects
- The 1 Star Totem's fragments are now visible after explosion to inform the player on the situation
- Adjustments to the Gravity Zone boundaries to allow closer disembarkation for player at cluster planets

We hope you enjoy the first demo - and we’ll be back soon with more I NEED SPACE news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337180/I_NEED_SPACE/

Laters Explorers!
- El & the Khayalan Arts crew
